reviewScope.pageOrdering: numeric printed-page labels from the pinned Gallica pagination service
reviewScope.componentScope: original French prose explicitly attributable to Jacques Sevin

selection.criterion: A production record must describe a self-contained game rather than merely name a game, report that games occurred, or narrate a camp programme.

candidatePassagesReviewed.finding: Reports that renewed games and camp-fire items formed part of a wolf-cub training course, without identifying or explaining a game.
A participant reflects on the educational value of exercises and games; it supplies no game rules and belongs to an excluded quoted testimonial.
Describes aggregate programme items, Jungle dramatizations, festivities and learning through play, but not enough rules to reproduce a discrete game.
Mentions that a small group constrained the games in a course; no game is described.
Notes that some demonstrations and games require more participants; no individual game is identified or described.
Uses play metaphorically while discussing adult trainees; it is not an activity description.

termEvidence.note: Every occurrence was reviewed in page context; the list is discovery evidence, not a claim that each page contains a candidate game.

excludedMaterialHandling.mixedPageBlocks: kept in scratch and excluded according to the accepted component-scope review
excludedMaterialHandling.wholeExcludedPages: not sent to the production extraction scope

result.reason: The approved prose is a historical account of the camp school. It contains programme-level mentions of games but no self-contained game rules eligible for the V3-R1 production corpus.
